name: Plague Inc: The Board Game - Designer Diseases
summary:
Become the fanciest disease in the bloodstream with the Designer Diseases pack.

This is a cosmetic pack that gives you a whole host of options to customise how your plague looks. With over 20 new colours and 8 new shapes, you'll be the envy of every pathogen in the world!
